# Goal
Implement T2 of ticket #116 spec r6: advertised search schema reflects effective bounds.
Read `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket02-spec-r6.md` AD12, AC3/AC6/AC8 and T2 first.

# Files (exact write scope)
- internal/catalog/schema.go
- internal/catalog/catalog_test.go
- internal/service/tools.go
- internal/service/projection.go
- internal/service/session_exposure.go
- internal/service/tools_test.go
- internal/service/progressive_projection_test.go
- internal/service/builtin_guidance_test.go
- internal/service/tool_metadata_test.go
- internal/service/service_edge_test.go
- internal/service/tools_publish_atomic_test.go
- internal/service/bounded_delivery_test.go
- internal/service/retrieve_result_test.go

# Required implementation
- internal/catalog/schema.go: SearchToolsInputSchema(topKDefault, topKMax int); remove static TopKDefault/TopKMaximum consts; update comment; top_k default/maximum use parameters.
- internal/service/tools.go: renderBuiltinDescriptors(resolvedPins, topKDefault, topKMax int); pass through at the descriptor call; ToolSurface gains stored bounds in NewToolSurface via cfg.Search.EffectiveBounds() and an unexported searchBounds() accessor returning stored pair when both nonzero else cfg.Search.EffectiveBounds() (zero-value cfg → 3/4); all advertisement readers use searchBounds().
- projection.go: prepareProjection and preparePinProjection gain the two bounds params; their call sites pass surface.searchBounds(). session_exposure.go likewise.
- Update the ten direct-literal &ToolSurface sites ONLY if RED, preserving each original scenario. Update catalog test and service tests with fixture-consistent bounds. Remove no zero-bounds fallback.
- Add RED TestSearchToolsSchemaHonorsBounds: (3,4) → default=3/maximum=4; (1,1) → 1/1. No degenerate-config oracle.

# Prohibited
Do not change describe/call/retrieve schemas; do not narrow operator config bounds; no degenerate-config advertisement assertions; keep the zero-bounds fallback; no unrelated files; no commits.

# Verify
Run `go test -count=1 ./internal/catalog ./internal/service`, report exact command, exit code, and output. If a production call site cannot reach the surface bounds, or a test cannot pass without weakening its scenario, STOP and report BLOCKED with exact site and failure.
